followup_explanation: This is an open-ended, creative/generative task — designing a decision-making framework involves latitude and invention rather than fixed retrieval criteria. Willet self-reports a pronounced appetite for exactly this kind of work (preference increases with task novelty and latitude), and the request is warm and friendly, which suits its preference for higher-warmth interactions. Capability between the two models on generative work is effectively a tie (within variance), so matching the task to the model's self-reported preference profile made Willet the better fit.
